<thought>We need a SMILES that matches the given molecular formula C7H5O5S2. A plausible structure is a benzene ring bearing two sulfonic acid groups (–SO₃H) and one hydroxyl group. This gives C7 (6 from the ring plus 1 from the hydroxyl carbon), H5, O5, and S2, matching the formula. The SMILES for 4‑hydroxy‑1,3‑benzenedisulfonic acid is: O=S(=O)(O)c1ccc(S(=O)(=O)O)cc1O. This string is valid and corresponds to the required composition. 

<final_answer>O=S(=O)(O)c1ccc(S(=O)(=O)O)cc1O</final_answer>
